news.headline: A Brand-New Dinosaur Gets Its Name
news.body: Scientists at London's Natural History Museum took a fresh look at fossil bones found at a brick factory in England back in 2001, and realized they belong to a dinosaur nobody had named before! It's called Paludohadros proudlovii. This plant-eater walked on four legs, had a spiky thumb, and lived in muddy swamps about 125 million years ago. It was about the size of a rhino, and grown-ups of its kind may have been twice as big.

news.headline: A Pretend Mars Crew Comes Home After a Year
news.body: Four volunteers have spent 378 days living inside a 3D-printed pretend Mars home at NASA's Johnson Space Center in Texas. They grew plants, did practice spacewalks, and waited a long time for messages, just like real Mars explorers would. On Saturday, October 31, they will step outside for the first time in more than a year! What NASA learns will help astronauts get ready for trips to the Moon and Mars.

news.headline: Two Baby Antelopes Arrive at a Minnesota Zoo
news.body: Como Park Zoo in St. Paul, Minnesota, welcomed two baby nyala, a kind of antelope from southern Africa with stripes on its sides. The first calf, a boy named Hubert, was born October 3. His little sister arrived just 20 days later! Here's a fun twist: the new girl's mom is Hubert's big sister, so Hubert's mom became a new mom and a new grandma in the same month. Volunteers will name the baby girl on November 5.

fun_fact: When scientists first found an Iguanodon's spiky thumb bone about 200 years ago, they thought it was a horn and put it on the dinosaur's nose! 🦖

word_of_the_day.sentence: The crew lived in a Mars simulation so they could practice for a real trip to Mars.

this_day_in_history: On October 28, 1886, the Statue of Liberty was officially opened in New York Harbor. She was a gift from the people of France to the United States! 🗽
did_you_know: Boy and girl nyala look very different. Grown-up boys are dark gray with long, twisty horns, while girls are reddish-brown with bright white stripes and no horns. 🦌
